feature.name: Jinja2 extension loading
feature.description: Extract Jinja2 extension registration, loading, and template integration as a standalone package.
included_behaviors: load extensions by import path string or Extension subclass
register extension tags and preprocessors with Environment
render templates using bundled loopcontrols and do extensions
excluded_behaviors: CLI, original tests, docs, packaging metadata

entanglement.description: Extension loading couples Environment initialization, parser tag registration, and compile/render pipeline hooks.
signals: load_extensions resolves import strings and binds to Environment
extensions mutate lexer/parser state during Environment setup

output.import: from featurelifted import Environment, Extension, nodes

public_spec.title: Jinja2 extension loading
public_spec.summary: Extract a task-scoped subset of `jinja2` into a standalone `featurelifted` package.

behaviors.text: The extracted feature must support this observable behavior: load extensions by import path string or Extension subclass. Required observable cases include preprocess extension rewrites delimiters.

The extracted feature must support this observable behavior: register extension tags and preprocessors with Environment. Required observable cases include preprocess extension rewrites delimiters; custom extension tag renders.
The extracted feature must support this observable behavior: iterate extensions in priority order. Required observable cases include extension ordering by priority.

The extracted feature must support this observable behavior: render templates using bundled loopcontrols and do extensions. Required observable cases include loopcontrols extension breaks loop; do extension executes side effect; preprocess extension rewrites delimiters; custom extension tag renders.
